comment: The damping knob is mapped exponentially onto the resonator's quality factor, from about 2 at the bottom of the travel to 50000 at the top (tine.cpp:156), which is why almost all the useful ring lengths sit in the last quarter of the knob. The strike is a half-sine arch a fixed number of samples long (tine.cpp:227), not the trigger voltage itself, so the jack's level does not change how hard the resonator is struck.
